comments.body: 2026-11-10 board review: closed, answered when a_2YACcy3xg shipped. 814ab861 starts the daemon with the app's environment allowlist, without the platform locale, and drops SSH_AUTH_SOCK for an ssh caller; 65e87275 moved launching into muster-daemon-launch so the CLI no longer pulls muster-daemon-client.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-04 while scoping a_2YACcy3xg (msg verbs start a daemon when none runs). The app starts its daemon with environment::for_daemon(inherited, platform_locale(), commands_path()), where the locale and commands path come from the shell. A daemon started by `muster msg` from an agent's pane or a plain terminal would hand that process's environment to every pane it later makes, for the daemon's whole life. Options: inherit the caller's (simplest, surprising), rebuild a login environment the way the app's launch does, or refuse to start one and keep exit 3. Also found: muster-daemon-client pulls muster-detect, muster-ssh, sha2 and tar into the CLI (size unmeasured). Decide before building a_2YACcy3xg.
title: Which environment does a daemon started by muster msg give its panes?
